faq_heading: Homes near James Ardiel Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the James Ardiel Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the James Ardiel Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names James Ardiel Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to James Ardiel Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Surrey Traditional (0.2 km north-east), Forsyth Road Elementary (1.0 km south) and Theresa Clarke Elementary (1.5 km south-west).

James Ardiel Elementary is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 13751 112 Ave. It teaches grades K to 7.
Below are the homes currently for sale whose listing mentions James Ardiel Elementary.
How the James Ardiel Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names James Ardiel Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit some distance away. Ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of James Ardiel Elementary

18 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of James Ardiel Elementary in a straight line (15 elementary, 3 secondary; 4 independent). The closest is Surrey Traditional, 0.2 km away, and the farthest on this list is Khalsa School Old Yale Road, 3.0 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Honour Secondary School (1.6 km); the nearest independent school is Our Lady of Good Counsel (1.5 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is K B Woodward Elementary (1.8 km). Other elementary schools close by: Surrey Traditional (0.2 km north-east), Forsyth Road Elementary (1.0 km south), Theresa Clarke Elementary (1.5 km south-west), Our Lady of Good Counsel (1.5 km south), Ellendale Elementary (1.6 km east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Surrey Traditional, 0.2 km north-east of James Ardiel Elementary.
